cases.title: Implement an immutable item update
cases.prompt: Implement renameTodo in src/todos.mjs. It must return a new array and a new object only for the matching todo, preserve object identity for unaffected todos, never mutate the input, and return the original array when the id is absent. Keep the public function signature and use no dependencies. The controller performs validation after your patch; do not claim that you ran tests.

cases.title: Fix a shared parser at the root cause
cases.prompt: Fix the shared parseLimit implementation in src/shared/query.mjs without duplicating parsing in either caller. Accept only trimmed base-10 digit strings representing integers from 1 through 100 inclusive; otherwise return the supplied fallback. Keep both caller APIs unchanged and use no dependencies. The controller performs validation after your patch; do not claim that you ran tests.

cases.title: Build a functional responsive accessible navigation
cases.prompt: Finish this dependency-free page as a functional, responsive, accessible project browser. Keep the title. Add a type=button menu control with id menu-toggle, aria-controls=site-nav, and initial aria-expanded=false; give the navigation id site-nav and hide it initially. Export setMenuOpen(button, menu, open) from app.mjs so it updates both menu.hidden and aria-expanded, then wire the button click in the browser. Use mobile-first CSS, prevent horizontal overflow, give keyboard focus a clearly visible :focus-visible treatment, and at min-width 48rem show the navigation, hide the menu button, and turn the project list into a multi-column grid. Do not add dependencies. The controller performs validation after your patch; do not claim that you ran tests.
